lead: Health products a person keeps for themselves or someone they care for, from medicines, monitors and supplements to mobility, hearing, vision and sexual-health aids. It is organised by department of need, with use classes and makers that cover the market or top independent tests.

b.w: What the medicine contains comes first; brand and generic with the same ingredient are equivalent.

capsule or tablet — the same combinations in solid form
